Stationary
Fixture feature: a stationary solver (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.sol(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Stationary");

DESCRIPTION
TABLE 6-10: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS FOR STATIONARY.

PROPERTY                     VALUES                            DEFAULT          DESCRIPTION

damp                         auto | on | off                   auto             Fixture text for Stationary.damp.
maxiter                      positive integer                  25               Fixture text for Stationary.maxiter.
minstep                      positive double                   1.0E-6           Fixture text for Stationary.minstep.
ntol                         positive double                   0.001            Fixture text for Stationary.ntol.
reltol                       positive double                   1e-6             Fixture text for Stationary.reltol.
segterm                      iter | tol | itertol              itertol          Fixture text for Stationary.segterm.


Eigenvalue
Fixture feature: an eigenvalue solver (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.sol(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Eigenvalue");

DESCRIPTION
TABLE 6-12: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS FOR EIGENVALUE.

PROPERTY                     VALUES                            DEFAULT          DESCRIPTION

neigs                        positive integer                  6                Fixture text for Eigenvalue.neigs.
shift                        double                            0                Fixture text for Eigenvalue.shift.
shiftactive                  on | off                          off              Fixture text for Eigenvalue.shiftactive.
eigref                       double                            0                Fixture text for Eigenvalue.eigref.
